overview: You wrote that the bellows-mender's voice will have to be a girl's, and you set the line down as it stands. You had not yet written the brake.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the page from the workmen through to the queen

important_dates.meaning: Wrote the bellows-mender's line for a girl's voice

summary: Wrote the page from the workmen through to the queen
